handoffSummary.stopReason: All 4 concurrent groups (25 titles each) began research in parallel. Group 1's very first CSM fetch (The Magic Faraway Tree) returned ETIMEDOUT; a second CSM URL (Nacho Libre) also timed out, while a control fetch of a non-CSM page (Wikipedia) succeeded instantly, indicating the failure was specific to commonsensemedia.org rather than a general fetch problem. Per protocol, Group 1 signaled a block to the shared scripts/csm-rate-guard.mjs state file, and each other group's next acquire call picked up that block and stopped immediately without retrying or falling back to another source. The nightly request counter was at 77/220 when the block was signaled -- this was not a quota exhaustion, it looks like CSM either rate-limiting or otherwise blocking/throttling this fetcher's requests specifically.
handoffSummary.nextClaudeAction: Before resuming: verify commonsensemedia.org is actually reachable via WebFetch from a fresh session (try 2-3 real review URLs in isolation, no concurrency) rather than immediately re-running all 4 groups again -- repeating the same concurrent-group approach without first confirming connectivity risks an immediate repeat block. See docs/nightly-content-flag-backfill-claude-run2-handoff-2026-09-07.md for the full remaining candidate list and next steps.
